record.one_liner: Freshdesk is a cloud helpdesk and customer support ticketing product from Freshworks.
record.auth_notes: Docs say the personal API key is sent as the Basic-auth username (curl -u apikey:X) with any dummy password. API key is found under Profile settings in the Support Portal.
record.access_notes: Every new account starts with a 14-day trial with full access to all product features. After the trial, the account can move to a 6-month Free Program (2 agents) or a paid plan; the Free Program docs do not list API access, and the legacy free Sprout plan explicitly has no API access (API from Blossom onwards). critic: confirmed self_serve_trial; Free Program API status unverified so not upgraded to self_serve_free.
record.api_notes: REST API v2 with Basic-auth API key; examples use endpoints such as /api/v2/tickets. Rate limits vary by plan.
record.blocker_notes: Trial path gives self-serve API key for building and testing; ongoing use needs a paid plan after the trial. Official MCP server (API-key auth) documented on vendor support site and stated generally available from September 10, 2026, with plan-based action allowances (MCP actions add-on $15/1000 actions). critic: mcp official confirmed; GA note added.
